name: @arena/capability-economics-service
description: Arena capability-economics reference service (Work Order C016; issue #122). Wires the @arena/capability-economics domain core to injected source ports only — the C010 ledger read surface (the REQUIRED commercial backing; a missing ledger is a typed fail-closed denial, never a silent skip), the C009 validation-outcome and C015 routing-decision read surfaces, the C005/expert-session effort-signal read surface and the Q1.0 capability-lift value source — computing and serving unit-economics read models with tenant isolation, idempotent supersession-by-append recomputation and durable idempotent recompute jobs over the A015 job-protocol submission identity. No service-to-service imports (boundary rule B2); hosts wire the real read surfaces, the reference fabric wires in-memory ones.
